propagate_wave_amplitude: propagate wave amplitudes by a given distance using layer eigensolve eigenvalues and exponential phase factors
colocate_forward_backward_amplitudes: compute forward and backward propagating wave amplitudes at a specified z offset within a layer
compute_amplitude_poynting_flux: compute the Poynting flux associated with forward and backward eigenmodes using eigenvectors and the A matrix
compute_directional_poynting_flux: compute total forward and backward Poynting flux by separating eigenmodes with positive and negative flux
compute_3d_stack_fields: compute three-dimensional electric and magnetic fields on a real-space grid across a stack of layers
